messages:
samantha: Scheduling Douglas Labs private cutover — Wed 2026-03-24 23:00 PT (quiet window). Planned change: model runtime bump v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0 on their dedicated pool. Asking for go/no-go and any blockers. 

samantha: Key notes: customer KMS rotation scheduled same day (handled separately), no schema/db changes, canary will be 5% traffic for 15m, rollback plan documented below. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/douglas-labs-v2.2.0 

samantha: Pinned artifacts: sha: abcdef123456. Deploy plan: canary -> monitor -> gradual traffic shift -> full cutover if metrics stable. /cc @raj @oliver @megan-oncall @cs-liz @securitybot :eyes:

deploybot: Preflight summary:
• infra-health: OK
• node-pools: ready (gpu-dedicated-3)
• ci-artifact: available (abcdef123456)
• active-incidents: none
• KMS-access-test: pending (raj to confirm)

raj: KMS access check — completed. Service account douglas-deploy-sa has decrypt/encrypt roles in customer KMS. :white_check_mark:

oliver: Quick question — any KV-cache invalidation or snapshot restore needed on rollback?

samantha: Good q. No invalidation planned. Rollback uses snapshot restore for kvcache from 03-24-22:30 PT snapshot if we see cache corruption. Normal rollback just routes back to v2.1.3 and drains new pods.

megan-oncall: I'll be on pager for the window. My thresholds: sustained p95 generation latency >200ms or error rate >1% for 5m triggers rollback. I will announce and initiate if hit.

product-lead: Product OK with the release notes and regression checklist. Confirming we have the prompt-set evals run against v2.2.0 and no perf regressions on safety tests.

cs-liz: Customer success notified, their ops team scheduled standby at 22:30 PT. They asked we avoid any client-side key rotations during the 23:00-00:30 window.

securitybot: Automated scan complete — no new high findings. Confirm KMS policy change required? None.

deploybot: Canary started (5% -> 2 pods). Observability snapshot: 
```
canary.metrics: p50=22ms, p95=78ms, errors=0.12%
cpu=34% memory=68%
```

raj: Looks fine. KMS key TTL check passed.

oliver: Approving from infra side — node drain steps in place and autoscaler locked at min replicas. :thumbsup:

samantha: Rollback procedure (short):
1) deployctl rollback --env private --tenant douglas --from v2.2.0 --to v2.1.3
2) verify route shift and health endpoints /health and /model/info
3) if kvcache mismatch, restore snapshot: restore-kvcache --tenant douglas --snapshot 2026-03-24-2230
4) open incident and notify customer-success + product

samantha: (command copy) ```deployctl rollback --env private --tenant douglas --to v2.1.3 --reason "auto/ops"```

megan-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll post live metrics to this thread during the window and act per thresholds.

product-lead: +1 from me.

cs-liz: Customer ops confirms standby and will escalate if they see errors.

samantha: Final checks: security? raj? infra? ops? If no blockers, I'll flip schedule to locked and hit the deploy button at 23:00 PT.

raj: Security good. No blockers from my side.

oliver: Infra good. Locking autoscaler and disabling auto-scaling policies for the window.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled: start=2026-03-24T23:00:00-07:00, mode=canary(5%), artifact=abcdef123456. Slack thread will update with stage markers.

samantha: Greenlight from me — proceeding on Wed 23:00 PT unless someone objects in the next 2h.

product-lead: Approved. GO for Wed. :rocket:

megan-oncall: I'll be online and watching. Post-deploy playbook pinned.

samantha: Thanks all — I'll post postmortem template and final release notes after the window.

deploybot: NOTE: If any participant reacts with :x: within the quiet window prep hr, deployment will be aborted and a hold created.
